svg.title: How the translation agent translates the Bible: one passage at a time, then the whole edition
svg.desc: Each book is cut into passages. For a passage the agent reads only the source, admits what it may use, a model drafts words and an alignment, code aligns and checks each verse, a model revises up to twice if a check fails, the best pass is kept and proposed. The edition is assembled verse by verse from the proposals, audited by another model family with confirmed defects sent back to be drafted again, and published under a signed root.
svg.text: How the translation agent translates the Bible
The harness behind RBS: Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek into American English. It runs one passage at a time, and the edition is built from what the passages leave.
only if a check fails, up to two rounds

svg.text: a confirmed defect: the verses around it are
drafted again, and the new verse must pass a rule
